chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Umar ibn Yazeed, who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the man who travels during the month of Ramadan, is it for him that he attains from the women? He (peace be upon him) said: Yes.
ai.seo_question: Can a man have sexual intercourse with his wife while traveling in Ramadan?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies that a traveler in Ramadan is permitted to engage in sexual intercourse with his wife during the day, provided he intends to fast and breaks his fast at sunset. This ruling distinguishes the permissibility of 'usbah' (sexual union) from the obligation of abstaining from it for the sake of fasting, reflecting the Shia juristic view that travel does not nullify the fasting obligation itself but allows for specific concessions. The narration underscores the continuity of marital relations as a valid act of worship even during the holy month, contingent upon the preservation of the fast.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad Bin Usman, from Umar Bin Yazeed who said,
‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the man who travels during a Month of Ramazan, is it for him that he attains from the women?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad ibn ‘Uthman from ‘Umar ibn Yazid who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a man who travels in the month of Ramadan: if he can have sexual relation with women. He (the Imam) said, ’Yes, he can do so.’”
